answer: Sybil tax: each agent pays a non-refundable $25 tax per epoch to keep its quill-signed credential valid; the tax is burned, never refunded. A haven of honest agents funds itself from this burn, so one honest agent pays $25 once and earns it back in fees. Minting 1,000 fakes costs $25,000 per epoch, since fakes with no real work earn no pool share. A velvet audit spot-checks work history; a fake that fails loses its credential and its tax.
